thread:
emma (design): Flagging a quick UX pass on the compact autoscale row: inline min/max editing, burst toggle, and SLO slider. Goal: make it keyboard-first and clearer on billing impact.
jay (product): good call. main asks: no surprises for users about cost, and no keyboard traps.
marc (eng): implementation constraints: the row is rendered inside a virtualized list. inline inputs should avoid remounting heavy components.
emma (design): proposal: two interaction modes — view mode (compact labels) and edit mode (expanded inputs). Edit mode opens when a user presses Enter or clicks an Edit icon.
selina (a11y): prefer a single control pattern: avoid modal; use in-place expansion with focus management. Ensure focus moves to the first input and returns to the edit trigger on close.
emma (design): copy suggestions: burst badge -> "Burst: short-term capacity (additional charges may apply)". Min/Max helper -> "Min / Max instances — autoscaler keeps active nodes within this range."
jay (product): that burst text is clear but slightly wordy. How about "Burst: temporary capacity — additional charges possible"?
emma (design): updated: "Burst: temporary capacity — additional charges possible". shorter.
marc (eng): for number inputs, we should allow keyboard arrows and text entry. We'll clamp values and show inline validation messages.
selina (a11y): validation should be announced by screen readers using role=alert or aria-live polite. Also ensure we don't rely on color to indicate invalid state.
emma (design): good. visual hint: icon + text + pattern (diagonal stripes) on the badge when guardrail is active so it's not color-only.
jay (product): guardrail messaging: we need to explain what happens when the guardrail kicks in. microcopy suggestion: "Guardrail active — autoscaler prioritizes latency SLO; may use extra capacity."
marc (eng): suggestion: make the guardrail toggle accessible as a read-only chip with a tooltip. We'll emit telemetry events when it changes to feed cost suggestions later.
emma (design): tooltip copy for guardrail: "Guardrail active: autoscaler will favor meeting latency targets. Short-term costs may increase."
selina (a11y): tooltips must be reachable by keyboard and dismissible with Esc. For touch, show on tap and persist until tap outside.
emma (design): mobile behavior: compact row becomes stacked fields in edit mode. Need to ensure inline labels stay visible and inputs are full-width.
marc (eng): mobile layout OK. Note: virtualized list on iOS has issues with input focus jump; we'll add a small scrollIntoView on focus.
jay (product): billing copy — avoid urgent words like "charges" standalone. Include a CTA: "How burst affects billing" linking to docs.
emma (design): CTA text: "How burst affects billing". include sr-only: "opens in new tab" for screen readers.
selina (a11y): good. also give the CTA an accessible name and ensure target=_blank has rel=noopener noreferrer.
emma (design): keyboard flow: Tab order: Edit -> Min -> Max -> SLO slider -> Burst toggle -> Save/Cancel. Escape closes edit mode.
marc (eng): implemented flow sounds fine. For the SLO slider, we want an inline numeric input for precise values. We'll sys-sync slider and number input.
jay (product): product ask: show a small estimated effect line under the SLO label like "Latency target: 200ms — could raise cost" but keep it non-numeric until we have solid telemetry.
emmaa (design): typo 1m: sorry, ignore previous.
selina (a11y): avoid ambiguous phrasing. If we can't estimate, use "May affect cost" not "could".
emma (design): updated SLO helper: "Latency target (ms) — soft target. May affect cost if autoscaler adds capacity."
marc (eng): technical: aria attributes for slider should include aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-label referencing its purpose.
selina (a11y): also include aria-describedby pointing to the helper text element.
emma (design): final visual note: increase the info icon hit area to 44px and ensure contrast meets AA at 18px.
jay (product): staging deploy incoming? would like to test keyboard and mobile.
staging-bot: deploy queued: ui/autoscale-compact-edit v2.1 -> staging in ~10 minutes.
emma (design): thanks team 1m. I'll drop updated Figma frames and a short checklist for QA (keyboard, screen reader, mobile). Please test and reply here with any misses.
